company.name: Droobi Health
company.shortDescription: A digital behavioral  company  to  empowering people with chronic conditions through healthier lifestyle
company.description:
Droobi is a digital therapeutic product that combines proven behavioral science technique, data analytics, artificial intelligence, and personalized support to help people build healthier habits to reduce the risk factors for developing chronic diseases.  
Droobi Health designs bilingual (Arabic & English) digital health solutions for prevention and management of chronic diseases prevalent in MENA region. With a focus on conditions that primarily rely on behavioral modifications such as diabetes and obesity.
